574-687-5004--73.description:
Activate Vish Kal by sacrificing Cathodion.
Cathodion triggers, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Resolve the Vish Kal ability, putting 3 +1/+1 counters on it.
Activate Vish Kal by sacrificing your persist/undying creature.
The creature's persist/undying ability triggers, returning it to the battlefield with a vigilance counter and the appropriate choice of a +1/+1 or -1/-1 counter.
Resolve the Vish Kal ability, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on it equal to the sacrificed creature's power.
Activate Tayam by paying {3} and removing both counters from your persist/undying creature and one counter from another creature, millling three cards and returning Cathodion from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

1829-2946-4871-5670.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is 2 or higher.
1829-2946-4871-5670.notablePrerequisites: A non-Skeleton creature has died under your control this turn.
1829-2946-4871-5670.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing Cult Conscript.
When Cult Conscript dies, Vindictive Vampire and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Vindictive Vampire trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Cult Conscript by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

803-6871-6879-8095.notablePrerequisites: You have an artifact creature in hand with the mana to cast it.
803-6871-6879-8095.description:
Cast any artifact creature by paying its mana cost.
When the artifact creature enters as an Ally due to Arcane Adaptation, Haru triggers, earthbending the artifact creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing the artifact creature.
When the creature dies, Haru triggers, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the creature enters as an Ally due to Arcane Adaptation, Haru triggers, earthbending the creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Hammerhead.
Repeat from step 3.

3532-5078-6769-8176.easyPrerequisites: There are at least two counters on creatures you control.
3532-5078-6769-8176.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Diving Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters the battlefield, Surge Conductor triggers, putting a counter on a creature you control that already has a counter on it.
Repeat.

4050-4381-4694-7306.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
4050-4381-4694-7306.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing a creature with a +1/+1 counter on it, adding one mana of any color.
When that creature dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen artifact token for each +1/+1 counter on the sacrificed creature. These artifacts are also 0/0 creatures due to March of the Machines.
Each Mutagen artifact creature token enters with at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to Grumgully.
Repeat from step 1.

3899-6132-6981.description:
Cast Perigee Beckoner for its warp cost by paying {1}{B}.
When Perigee Beckoner enters, it triggers, targeting Metamorphosis Fanatic.
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Perigee Beckoner.
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Metamorphosis Fanatic.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it triggers, returning Perigee Beckoner from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Perigee Beckoner enters, it triggers, targeting Metamorphosis Fanatic.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability from step 4.
Repeat from step 3.

222-527-2079-6495.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Saproling.
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
222-527-2079-6495.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Evereth twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.
222-527-2079-6495.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

uses.n: Sephiroth, Fabled SOLDIER // Sephiroth, One-Winged Angel

1981-2415-6578-8095.easyPrerequisites: You either have Sephiroth, Fabled SOLDIER on the battlefield or have the emblem granted by Sephiroth, One-Winged Angel.
1981-2415-6578-8095.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Sephiroth and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Sephiroth trigger, causing you to gain life and an opponent to lose life.
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Repeat.

1874-1981-2415-4050.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
1874-1981-2415-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Ajani's Welcome triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.

4316-5078-7913.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Repeat

2034-4871-5795-7147-7646.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Wretched Throng, adding {C}{C}.
When Wretched Throng dies, it and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Holding priority, activate Barkform Harvester by paying {2}, putting Wretched Throng from your graveyard onto the bottom of your library.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Wretched Throng trigger, putting Wretched Throng from your library into your hand.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Cast Wretched Throng by paying {U} due to Krallenhorde Howler.
Repeat.

240-2438-5929.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies as an Egg due to Leyline of Transformation, Atla triggers, revealing a creature card from your library and putting it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat as desired / able.
240-2438-5929.notes: The combo can continue as long as there are creature cards in your library.

772-2438-3175.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Sun Titan.
When Sun Titan dies, Shade's Form triggers, returning Sun Titan from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sun Titan enters, it triggers, returning Shade's Form from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Sun Titan.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.

3764-5315-7363.description:
Activate Summoning Station by tapping it, creating a 2/2 Pincher creature token and a Mutagen token due to Donatello.
Activate Ravenous Intruder by sacrificing the Mutagen.
Summoning Station triggers, untapping itself.
Resolve the Ravenous Intruder ability.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

647-1563-3899-6753.description:
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by paying {1} and removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the tokens, putting two charge counters on Spawning Pit.
Repeat.

1796-6867-7042.description:
Cast Appa, Steadfast Guardian by paying {W}{W}.
When Appa, Steadfast Guardian enters, it triggers, airbending Appa, Loyal Sky Bison
Cast Appa, Loyal Sky Bison from exile by paying {0}.
Appa, Steadfast Guardian triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token.
When Appa, Loyal Sky Bison enters, it triggers, airbending Appa, Steadfast Guardian
Cast Appa, Steadfast Guardian from exile by paying {0}.
Repeat from step 2.

1483-3967-6972--112.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Weaponcraft Enthusiast.
When Weaponcraft Enthusiast dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Weaponcraft Enthusiast enters, its fabricate ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.
1483-3967-6972--112.notes: The chosen anthem effect must boost Weaponcraft Enthusiast's toughness by at least 1 so it doesn't die from the -1/-1 counter.

1778-4053-6797-6989.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Memnite.
Cast Memnite from your graveyard by paying {0}. It will not enter with a finality counter on it due to Solemnity.
Repeat.

1170-1251-1329-1414.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Lotus Petal from your graveyard.
Cast Lotus Petal by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Emry.
When Emry enters, it triggers, causing you to mill four cards.
Activate Lotus Petal by tapping and sacrificing it.
Repeat.

997-1077-5571--6.description:
Donate Blightbeetle to an opponent
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing the undying creature.
When the undying creature dies, its undying ability triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to Blightbeetle.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat from step 2.

955-2457-3129-4289.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Activate two Insects by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat.

465-955-3742-4251-4452.notablePrerequisites: Rukarumel on the battlefield with "Samurai" chosen.
465-955-3742-4251-4452.description:
Declare Phantom Steed and Godo as attackers, triggering each of their second abilities.
Resolve the Godo trigger, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Resolve the Phantom Steed trigger, creating a token copy of Wormfang Drake.
When the token Wormfang Drake enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, exiling Godo.
At the end of your combat phase, Phantom Steed triggers, causing you to sacrifice the Wormfang Drake token.
When the token Wormfang Drake leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning Godo from exile to the battlefield.
When Godo enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, allowing you to search your library for an Equipment card and put it onto the battlefield.
Repeat each combat phase.

457-2350-5078-5390.description:
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0}.
Forensic Gadgeteer triggers, creating a Clue token.
Activate Urza's first ability by tapping the Clue, adding {U}.
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top from the battlefield on top of your library.
Activate the Clue by paying {1} and sacrificing it, causing you to draw Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library.
Repeat.

2034-2089-2351.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card during an opponent's turn.
2034-2089-2351.description:
Draw a card during an opponent's turn.
The Watcher's first ability riggers, creating a 1/1 Tentacle creature token.
When the Tentacle enters the battlefield, Symmetry Matrix triggers.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Tentacle, adding {C}{C}.
When the Tentacle dies, The Watcher's second ability triggers, untapping up to one Kraken you control.
Resolve the Symmetry Matrix trigger, causing you to pay {1} to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.

38-2644-4763.notablePrerequisites: Sai of the Shinobi attached to Skirk Prospector.
38-2644-4763.description:
Activate Skirk Prospector by sacrificing it, adding {R}.
When Skirk Prospector dies, Koll triggers, returning Skirk Prospector from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Skirk Prospector by paying {R}.
When Skirk Prospector enters the battlefield, Sai of the Shinobi triggers, attaching itself to Skirk Prospector.
Repeat.

1486-2466-4222.notablePrerequisites: Freed from the Real attached to Magda.
1486-2466-4222.description:
Activate Honor-Worn Shaku's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Honor-Worn Shaku's second ability by tapping Magda.
Magda triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Honor-Worn Shaku ability, untapping it.
Activate a Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Activate Freed from the Real's second ability by paying {U}, untapping Magda.
Repeat.

uses.n: Fable of the Mirror-Breaker // Reflection of Kiki-Jiki

1636-3337-4939.notablePrerequisites: Reflection of Kiki-Jiki does not have summoning sickness.
1636-3337-4939.description:
Activate Reflection of Kiki-Jiki by paying {1} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Burning-Tree Emissary with haste.
The Burning-Tree Emissary token enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Intruder Alarm.
Resolve the Burning-Tree Emissary trigger, adding {R}{G}.
Resolve the Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.

2292-4733-5038.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
2292-4733-5038.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing any other creature.
Dictate of Erebos triggers, causing each opponent to sacrifice a creature.
Overseer of the Damned triggers for each nontoken creature an opponent sacrificed, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token for each trigger.
Resolve the Viscera Seer trigger, causing you to scry 1.
Repeat.
You may also repeat this loop any time a nontoken creature enters the battlefield under the control of an opponent who controls no token creatures.

2819-4050-4499.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three opponents.
2819-4050-4499.description:
Activate Emiel by paying {3}, blinking Goblin Goliath.
Goblin Goliath enters the battlefield, creating at least three 1/1 Goblin creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the three Goblin tokens, adding {3}.
Repeat.

572-5125-5218.description:
Cast Sparkcaster by discarding Sandstorm Eidolon.
Sandstorm Eidolon triggers from your graveyard, returning from your graveyard to your hand.
Sparkcaster enters the battlefield, triggering twice.
Resolve the first Sparkcaster trigger, dealing 1 damage to target player or planeswalker.
Resolve the second Sparkcaster trigger, returning Sparkcaster from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
